settings.currencies_hint: Only the currencies you work with appear in items, balances and rates. The base currency is one of them.
settings.currencies_other_hint: Like a crypto currency (BTC). Enter its code and name; fetching its rate online only works if the source knows it.
settings.currencies_search: Search by code or name (English or Arabic)…
settings.currencies_confirm_remove: Remove {code} from your list? Its exchange rates are deleted too.
settings.rates_pair_hint: Enter the rate the way you know it; the other direction is worked out. One side must be the base currency.
settings.rates_period_hint: “To” is optional: empty keeps the rate going; with an end month the previous rate comes back after it.
settings.rates_test_hint: Fetches today's rate for each of your currencies now and shows it without saving, to check the source works.
settings.rates_hint: Each currency's rate against the base currency, per period. A rate holds from its start month until the next rate. Rates you enter here always win over rates fetched online.
settings.rates_to_hint: Leave empty to keep the rate going. After the period the previous rate comes back.
settings.rates_err_missing: Pick the currency and start month, and enter the rate
settings.rates_fetch_hint: Off by default. When on, the app fetches the rate of each currency a month uses when you open it (the last day's rate for ended months, today's for the current month) from a free open service; only the currency code and date are sent. Rates are available from March 2024; older months need a manual rate. Your manual rates always win.
settings.rates_fetch_none: Nothing new: every month has a manual or up-to-date rate, or the source couldn't be reached. Try “Test the source”.
settings.rates_confirm_delete: Delete the rate starting {from}? Its months take the rate before it.
settings.appearance_hint: Pick a ready theme or make your own. Automatic follows Windows light or dark mode.
settings.custom_hint: Starts from the current theme's colours. The preview is live; nothing is saved until you press Use my colours.
settings.warn_low_text_contrast: The text is close to the background colour and may be hard to read. You can still save it.
settings.excellent_rate_hint: Surplus as a share of income
settings.good_rate_hint: Below this the surplus counts as small
settings.emergency_cut_rate_hint: of net, until the emergency fund is complete
settings.currency_hint: All totals and calculations are shown in it.
settings.types_hint: The category drives the calculations (essential, luxury, installments, savings, emergency). The five core types can only be renamed. The original types follow the interface language; a name you change stays as you wrote it, and changing it back to the original makes it follow the language again.
settings.categories_hint: For grouping and filtering only; they don't affect allocation. Deleting a type leaves its goals without a type. The original types follow the interface language unless you rename them.
settings.templates_hint: Added automatically to every new month. Leave the amount empty if the price changes monthly (like electricity) and it will be marked “Needs a price”.
